commit.message:
DOC-7089: Migrate content/operate/oss_and_stack/ management, reference, and top-level index to render hooks

Converts the management/, reference/, and top-level _index.md pages under
content/operate/oss_and_stack/ off the relref/callout shortcodes onto the
DOC-6909 render hooks (unit 2 of 5 for DOC-7089, continuing DOC-6909/7047/
7059/7074/7079/7080). 18 of 28 files needed changes: 37 relref links and 9
callout shortcodes converted with build/migrate_shortcode_links.py,
including scaling.md's six percent-form `{{% alert title="Note" %}}`
blocks. Verified against a fresh origin/main build with
build/diff_rendered_hrefs.py — 0 href diffs, 0 new warnings. No indented/
list-nested callouts in scope, so the known indentation-loss tool bug
didn't apply here.

Ticket: DOC-7089
